Now we add color, reusing **حب (like)** and **عايز (want)** from the last lesson. The one new idea: in Arabic a color is an **adjective that agrees** with its noun. Tap any sentence to reveal its franco and English.

## How it works

**The basic colors have a masculine and a feminine form.** A masculine noun takes the *a‑* form, a feminine noun takes the *‑a* form: **القلم الأحمر (el-2alam el-a7mar)** = "the red pen", but **العربية الحمرا (el-3arabeyya el-7amra)** = "the red car". As with any adjective, the noun *and* the color both carry the article: *el-2alam el-azra2*.

**The "derived" colors don't change.** Colors that end in **‑i** — *bonny* (brown), *ramadi* (grey), *borto2ani* (orange), *bambi* (pink) — stay the same for masculine and feminine.

## The colors

| Masculine - franco | Feminine - franco | English |
|---|---|---|
| أحمر - a7mar | حمرا - 7amra | red |
| أزرق - azra2 | زرقا - zar2a | blue |
| أخضر - a5dar | خضرا - 5adra | green |
| أصفر - asfar | صفرا - safra | yellow |
| أبيض - abyad | بيضا - beda | white |
| إسود - eswed | سودا - soda | black |
| بني - bonny | بني - bonny | brown |
| رمادي - ramadi | رمادي - ramadi | grey |
| برتقاني - borto2ani | برتقاني - borto2ani | orange |
| بمبي - bambi | بمبي - bambi | pink |

## Things to color

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| لون / ألوان - loon / alwan | color / colors |
| قلم - 2alam (m.) | pen |
| قلم رصاص - 2alam rosas (m.) | pencil |
| كشكول - kashkool (m.) | notebook |
| ورقة - wara2a (f.) | sheet of paper |
| عربية - 3arabeyya (f.) | car |

## Examples

<details class="frase">
<summary>أنا بحب القلم الأزرق ده</summary>
<span class="fr">ana ba7ebb el-2alam el-azra2 da</span>
<span class="en">I like this blue pen</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>أنا عايز القلم الرصاص الإسود ده</summary>
<span class="fr">ana 3ayez el-2alam el-rosas el-eswed da</span>
<span class="en">I want that black pencil</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>أنا بحب القلم الأخضر ده</summary>
<span class="fr">ana ba7ebb el-2alam el-a5dar da</span>
<span class="en">I like this green pen</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>أنا عايز القلم البني ده</summary>
<span class="fr">ana 3ayez el-2alam el-bonny da</span>
<span class="en">I want that brown pencil</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>العربية الحمرا حلوة</summary>
<span class="fr">el-3arabeyya el-7amra 7elwa</span>
<span class="en">the red car is nice (feminine agreement)</span>
</details>

## Dialogue: choosing a color

Sami helps Mariam pick out pens.

<span class="rotulo">سامي — Sami</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>عايزة قلم بأي لون؟</summary>
<span class="fr">3ayza 2alam be-ayy loon?</span>
<span class="en">What color pen do you want?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">مريم — Mariam</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>عايزة قلم أزرق</summary>
<span class="fr">3ayza 2alam azra2</span>
<span class="en">I want a blue pen</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">سامي — Sami</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>وبتحبي القلم الرصاص ده؟</summary>
<span class="fr">we bit7ebbi el-2alam el-rosas da?</span>
<span class="en">And do you like this pencil?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">مريم — Mariam</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>لأ، بحب الأخضر أكتر</summary>
<span class="fr">la2, ba7ebb el-a5dar aktar</span>
<span class="en">No, I like green more</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">سامي — Sami</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>والعربية دي؟ حمرا حلوة</summary>
<span class="fr">wel-3arabeyya di? 7amra 7elwa</span>
<span class="en">And this car? Nice red</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">مريم — Mariam</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>أيوة، بحب اللون الأحمر</summary>
<span class="fr">aywa, ba7ebb el-loon el-a7mar</span>
<span class="en">Yes, I like the color red</span>
</details>

## Exercises

Try each one out loud first, then tap **Show answer**.

### Exercise 1 — Make the color agree

Give the right color form for the noun's gender.

**1.** القلم (m.) + blue

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">القلم الأزرق</span>
<span class="fr">el-2alam el-azra2</span>
</details>

**2.** العربية (f.) + red

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">العربية الحمرا</span>
<span class="fr">el-3arabeyya el-7amra</span>
</details>

**3.** الفستان (m.) + green

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">الفستان الأخضر</span>
<span class="fr">el-fustan el-a5dar</span>
</details>

**4.** الجيبة (f.) + black

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">الجيبة السودا</span>
<span class="fr">el-geeba el-soda</span>
</details>

**5.** البلوزة (f.) + white

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">البلوزة البيضا</span>
<span class="fr">el-boloza el-beda</span>
</details>

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>

</details>
